---
title: "Frequently Asked Questions"
---

## Course Structure

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Is there a project component?
**Yes and No.** Each assignment includes a project-like implementation question. This means:

- All students work on similar, well-defined problems
- You get hands-on experience with real deep learning implementations
- No separate final project required
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## What programming language and framework do we use?
**Python** with **PyTorch**. All assignments must be completed in Python using PyTorch. No other frameworks (TensorFlow, JAX, etc.) unless explicitly allowed.
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Do I need a GPU?
Not for all assignments, but some will benefit from GPU acceleration. Cloud compute credits (Google Cloud / Colab) will be provided. Details TBA.
:::

---

## Prerequisites

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## What background do I need?
While there are no formal prerequisites, you should be comfortable with:

- **Python Programming** — NumPy, matplotlib, basic OOP
- **Linear Algebra** — vectors, matrices, eigenvalues
- **Calculus** — partial derivatives, chain rule
- **Probability & Statistics** — distributions, expectations, Bayes' rule
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## I haven't taken a Machine Learning course. Can I still take this?
Yes, but expect to put in extra effort in the first few weeks. The course covers the necessary ML foundations before moving to deep learning topics.
:::

---

## Quizzes

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## What happens if I miss a quiz?
Quiz score = **0%**. The "best 3 out of 4" policy accommodates one missed quiz. **No makeup quizzes** for any reason.
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Are quizzes open book?
**No.** All quizzes are **closed book**. No notes, no electronic devices.
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## What is the quiz format?
Mix of **MCQs and subjective questions**. May include mathematical derivations, architecture diagrams, and conceptual questions.
:::

---

## Assignments

::: {.callout-warning collapse="true"}
## What if I miss an assignment deadline?
**No extensions** are granted for any reason.
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## How are assignments evaluated?
**Viva Voce Process:**

1. TAs compare submitted code with live demonstration
2. **No changes allowed** during viva
3. Code demonstration and Q&A session

**Grade Breakdown:**

- Code functionality: **50%**
- Understanding (viva): **25%**
- Code quality: **12.5%**
- Theory concepts: **12.5%**
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Individual or group work?
**Group assignments.** All team members receive the same grade. Team size TBA.
:::

---

## Classroom Policies

::: {.callout-warning collapse="true"}
## Can I use my laptop in class?
**No.** Laptops are **not permitted** in class for any reason.
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## What's the attendance policy?
See the detailed [attendance policy](./grading.qmd#attendance) in the grading section.
:::

---

## Audit Policy

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Can I audit the course?
**Lecture Attendance:** Free to attend all lectures.

**Limitations:**

- No assignment grading (limited TA capacity)
- Cannot formally join assignment teams
- No official course credit
:::
